units.source_text: 彩车内有现时名画家画的装饰画，彩车头也有像柱子那样的东西，据说那是当年朱印船 [4] 的桅杆。

en.t: Inside the festival float are decorative paintings by well-known contemporary artists, and at the front of the float there is also something like a pillar, which is said to be the mast of a vermilion-seal ship [4] from those days.
